text:
dan: noticing a sudden spike in provisional charges for foocorp in the console — looks like ~200 sessions flagged in the last 30m. anyone on billing/route side looking?

maya: saw it too, correlates with a flurry of streaming reconnects from eu-central. small clients, lots of short-lived sessions.

billing-bot: Billing: provisional charges emitted: 192 entries for customer=foocorp between 2026-03-20T10:40Z-11:10Z.

rahul: can you paste a couple trace ids? want to see if toolcalls were truncated vs graceful ends.

dan: grabbing logs — example snippet:
```
2026-03-20T11:12:03.123Z router: session=abc123 route=primary -> fallback=secondary reason=TFO
2026-03-20T11:12:03.124Z runtime: toolcall start id=tc-789 seq=42 truncated=true
2026-03-20T11:12:03.125Z ledger: provisional charge prov_id=prov-44 session=abc123 tokens=120 status=provisional host=host-a
2026-03-20T11:12:04.300Z runtime: client disconnect
2026-03-20T11:12:04.900Z runtime: reconnect session=abc123 resumed on host-b seq=43 ack=none
```

alexa: runtime didn't emit a final `toolcall.complete` — so ledger saw a provisional but host-b never confirmed it. did host-b even have the prov_id?

dan: that's the problem. host-b's resume path replays tokens/seq but we don't surface the original prov_id in the routing headers. current ledger confirm relies on local in-memory context or session->prov mapping on the same host.

maya: our dedupe window today uses client_ip + session_ttl for provisional resolution in fallback code. if client IP changes on reconnect, or we route to a different host, that mapping is lost and provisional never transitions.

rahul: sequence of failure: (1) host-a issues provisional; (2) client disconnect; (3) router routes resume to host-b (affinity lost); (4) host-b processes the tail but doesn't correlate to prov_id; (5) provisional stays provisional -> shows up as a charge. possible double provisional if both hosts create one.

alexa: proposal A (system): add `X-Prov-Anchor: prov-<uuid>` header in router when we create a provisional charge, and persist prov_id as a first-class reference in ledger entries. on resume other hosts can lookup and confirm. requires router + ledger schema change + migrate reads.

dan: proposal B (UX short-term): mark provisional ledger entries in Console as `Pending (awaiting resume)` with trace link and host-last-seen. surface TTL and clear guidance for support — avoids immediate angry customers and reduces manual tickets.

maya: agree short-term UX helps. we should also add telemetry: sample traces for any provisional charge > 50 tokens or >5s toolcall. add metric `provisional_to_confirmed_ratio` per region so alerts can catch regressions.

rahul: also add a reconciliation job: scan provisional entries older than 1h, attempt to re-correlate by session_id + seq ranges across hosts, and if no match, mark for refund/auto-revert or human review.

alexa: on the implementation side, adding prov header is small in router but ledger needs to accept `prov_id` on write and index it (prov_id -> session mapping). index cost is minor but schema change needs coord with billing migration window.

dan: design ask: @design-team can we make the Console show `Pending (provisional)` with a one-click `Attach trace` and `Request refund` CTA for support? show probable reason: "stream truncated / reconnect".

support-bot: Ticket created: #1234 "FooCorp provisional spike" — attached sample traces and ledger rows. Assigning billing-oncall.

maya: one more risk: double-provisional on early-eof where both hosts issue provisional before either sees confirm. dedupe must be stronger than ip+ttl — maybe use prov-origin-nonce derived from client nonce + prov-anchor.

rahul: agree, dedupe key should be (prov_id || client_nonce || session_id || seq_range). if prov_id present, it's canonical. otherwise fall back to computed key.

alexa: implement non-blocking runtime emit: when we create provisional, emit `prov_anchor` event to ledger and to a tiny S3-ish kv (or redis) with short TTL so other hosts can read it. that avoids full migration. we can later make ledger authoritative.

dan: ok action items:
- (maya) UX: mark provisional rows as Pending + trace link (this week).
- (alexa) Router PR to include prov header + runtime emit `prov_anchor` (next week, coord with billing).
- (rahul) Reconcile job + metric `provisional_to_confirmed_ratio` (start design, implement 2w).
- (maya/ops) Alert threshold: provisional_rate > 0.5% of confirmed => page.

alexa: I'll open PRs and tag billing & infra. will stub migration docs.

dan: thanks all. let's keep this thread for rollout notes. if anyone sees more fooCorp rows ping here. :thumbsup:
